name: Neutrinos-Angra
summary: Neutrinos-Angra is a Brazilian surface-level water-Cherenkov reactor-antineutrino demonstrator beside Angra-II. It develops local instrumentation and analysis for safeguards applications in a high-background environment.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-doped water provides a hydrogen target and neutron-capture tag for inverse beta decay. Photomultipliers detect Cherenkov light; external veto volumes and reactor-on/off comparisons distinguish candidate antineutrinos from cosmic backgrounds.
